summary: Observation of silhouettes and removal of an object.
description: witness reported witnessing a peculiar phenomenon in 1964. Returning to the Le Bourget flight school around 2:30 a.m. on a Sunday in early March, he was surprised to regularly see a faint, short-lived glow about 200 to 300 meters away. Approaching the perimeter fence of the military base, he saw five figures moving near a device that had rested on the ground. The upper part of the object, illuminated by the glow, was rounded. The figures moved back and forth between the interior of the object and its immediate surroundings. Suddenly, the glow went out, and in total silence, the object rose a meter or two from the ground and remained stationary for one to two seconds. The witness described the object as having a round or oval shape, a flat underside, and a bumpy top in the center and along the sides. Its dimensions are 8 to 10 meters in diameter and its height 2.5 to 3 meters. This object rises vertically without transition at very high speed towards the south. No noise is heard, and a brief vertical trail appears, along with two other traces in the sky. The next day, the witness goes to the site of his observation and, although separated by about ten meters from the exact location by the fence of the military base, he notices a slight flattening of the grass and some shrubs. He decides not to tell anyone about this observation, for which we lack confirmed information. These seemingly very strange events, reported very late (June 2007) by a single witness, are unverifiable, and no serious analysis can be carried out.
